subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw remove the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` config value now and rely on doctor to migrate existing configs?
rationale: The patch is technically aligned with runtime support, but it intentionally changes a shipped config contract and rewrites existing operator config during repair.

options.title: Accept the doctor migration
options.body: Merge the stricter config contract with the legacy repair path after exact-head merge checks pass.

options.title: Keep grpc as a config contract
options.body: Pause or close this PR and sponsor a larger real gRPC exporter implementation instead of removing the advertised value.

recommendation.title: Accept the doctor migration
recommendation.body: Merge the stricter config contract with the legacy repair path after exact-head merge checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The original diagnostics exporter and config surface traces to `steipete`, making him the best available owner for accepting or redirecting the compatibility direction.
